name: zclass_animate_update_node
description: zClass_Animate::UpdateNode validates inputs, advances active animation runtime, stops completed animations, samples transforms, marks data dirty, and queues updated nodes.
known_limits: The Binary Ninja reconstruction marker remains limited because HLIL misrenders the runtime pointer and byte-sized node flag reuse; assembly was used as source truth. tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zClass animate/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x453bd0 validates null-node and null-class-data error returns, active status check, AdvanceTime stop handling, SampleTransform call on the runtime subobject, dirty-flag setting, type-list insertion when the queued flag is absent, and node flag updates.
The native smoke verifies the error paths, completed-animation stop path, transform sampling, data dirty flag, queued-tree insertion, and node flag updates.
